query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as linked, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as orphaned FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id;
